loglevel.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL

gopherroot.description: Top-level directory for Gopher content (filesystem path)

gopher_listen.description: Network interface to bind Gopher server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::')

gopher_port.description: TCP port for Gopher protocol (standard is 70)

gopher_enabled.description: Enable serving Gopher content (turn off to run HTTP-only)

http_listen.description: Network interface to bind HTTP server to

wap_listen.description: Network interface to bind WAP server to (experimental)

wap_enabled.description: Enable WAP interface for mobile devices (requires libwap)

title.description: Default site title shown in HTTP/WAP frontends and Gopher menus

hostname.description: Public hostname used in generated URLs and redirects

max_upload_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) allowed for POST data to CGI scripts

charset.description: Default character encoding for text responses

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for encrypted HTTP (HTTPS) and WAP (WAPS)

tls_cert.description: Path to PEM-encoded TLS certificate file

tls_key.description: Path to PEM-encoded TLS private key file

vhosts.description: Virtual host configurations — override site settings per hostname

title.description: Site-specific title (optional — defaults to global title)

logfile.description: Path to log file (use '-' to log to stdout)

log_rotate_size.description: Size (in bytes) at which to rotate log files

log_rotate_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep

syslog_enabled.description: Send logs to system syslog instead of a file

allowed_subnets.description: List of allowed IP ranges in CIDR notation (leave empty to allow all)

denied_subnets.description: List of blocked IP ranges in CIDR notation

ftp_gateway_port.description: Port of FTP server for gateway

ftp_gateway_pass.description: FTP password for gateway (store securely in production)
